references.text: The context for the cleansing process of a house with leprosy, where the stones are first removed and the walls scraped before new stones are set in.
Continuation of the procedure if the disease returns after new stones have been set in and the house has been replastered.
Describes the outcome when the house is clean after being replastered, showing that the procedure in verse 42 was successful.
Ezekiel's prophecy against those who plaster walls with loose whitewash, a symbolic parallel to the physical replastering of the house.
Instructions to use uncut stones for the altar, highlighting the importance of specific stones in ritual contexts.
